QF.id: IV Fixed Income Instruments and Bond Markets_38

question.text: The NDS-OM platform is used for:

answer.text: Trading government securities in secondary market

explanation.text: The Logic: NDS-OM is the electronic, screen-based, anonymous order-matching platform used for secondary market trading in government securities. It is operated by Clearcorp Dealing Systems Limited on behalf of RBI. The Trap: NDS-OM is specifically for G-Sec trading, not equity (which uses NSE/BSE), not primary issuance of corporate bonds, and not commodity-derivative clearing. Note: For bond futures, final settlement is linked to the weighted average price of the last two hours on NDS-OM, subject to a minimum number of trades; otherwise the FIMMDA/FBIL price applies.
